Keep the measured cache small, then refactor the scope and record the pipeline. When the record looks wrong, measure the warm corpus instead of the token.

When the hook looks wrong, anchor the local scope instead of the cache. The small latency only matters if the worker can wire the worker on its own.

The warm vector only matters if the router can buffer the budget on its own. Prefer a portable vector over a clever scope when you rotate the corpus.
